definitions.explanation: A feeling of wanting what someone else has; admiring while wishing to possess the same qualities or things.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{才能|さいのう}に{羨望|せんぼう}を{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: I feel envy at his talent.

examples.japanese: {羨望|せんぼう}の{眼差|まなざ}しで{見|み}られる。
examples.english: To be looked at with envious eyes.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{成功|せいこう}は{皆|みな}の{羨望|せんぼう}の{的|まと}だ。
examples.english: Her success is the object of everyone's envy.

notes:
NUANCE:
{羨望|せんぼう} can be positive (admiration mixed with desire) or negative (jealousy). It's more literary than {嫉妬|しっと} (jealousy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {羨望|せんぼう}の{的|まと}: object of envy
- {羨望|せんぼう}の{眼差|まなざ}し: envious gaze
- {羨望|せんぼう}を{抱|いだ}く: to harbor envy
- {羨望|せんぼう}に{値|あたい}する: to be worthy of envy

RELATED TERMS:
- {嫉妬|しっと}: jealousy (stronger, more negative)
- {羨|うらや}ましい: enviable
- {憧|あこが}れ: longing, admiration
